purpose: Aggregate shared Agent-native App resources for App and Studio from existing owner projections.

metadata_policy.authorization: owner-reported status and bounded consumer/grant counts; unknown when no authorization relation is projected
metadata_policy.connection_grant_aggregation: an active granted row for the same consumer supersedes historical stale or revoked rows; stale or revoked rows without an active grant remain attention
metadata_policy.connection_identity: safe connection id, provider type, and account label from the existing registry and authorization owner; never a credential handle or provider payload
metadata_policy.capability_ids: only capabilities of active granted rows; does not replace per-consumer authorization checks
metadata_policy.action_ids: only existing actions declared by the current owner read model; the consumer does not infer capabilities from the resource kind
metadata_policy.revision: owner security revision identity when provided; otherwise unknown; never include credential material
metadata_policy.freshness: owner observed or tested timestamp/status when provided; write time alone is not freshness
metadata_policy.readiness: owner or resource status summary with safe reason code only

shared_resources.secret_policy: refs_only; never include credential material, credential handles, provider payloads, or knowledge body
shared_resources.path_policy: do not include absolute filesystem paths; use stable source refs

authority_boundary.resource_truth: existing package, connection, model, workspace, and knowledge owners
authority_boundary.framework_role: aggregate safe refs and expose existing app_state/action routes

profiles.fast: bounded startup projection with full detail ref
profiles.full: same owner truth with complete safe resource rows

connection_and_model_policy.gateway_account: shown through model access only, not duplicated as a generic connection
connection_and_model_policy.model_access_ready: true maps to ready, false maps to attention, absent maps to unknown
connection_and_model_policy.credential_material: retained by the existing provider owner; shared resources expose safe references and owner actions only

action_boundary.owner_actions: existing package, connection, settings, knowledge, and managed-update actions
